scope: Complete displayed intelligence versus total evaluation cost Pareto line with all 694 catalog models selected; 189 eligible plotted points, every one read from its public tooltip. This is not ValueRank's composite-quality frontier.

completeness.note: All 694 catalog models selected; all 189 plotted points and all 18 Pareto path vertices captured from public tooltips (rounded integer Intelligence Index, two-decimal USD total cost). One overlapped circle pair was resolved by an offset hover with colour and axis confirmation. No hidden state or paid export used.

nearFrontierPolicy.basis: Public rounded integer Intelligence Index and two-decimal USD total cost from the chart tooltips. The frontier's intelligence at a point's cost is the highest intelligence among rendered-frontier points whose cost is at or below that cost; a point cheaper than every frontier point has no gap.
nearFrontierPolicy.text: A plotted configuration is near-frontier when it lies within 3 Intelligence Index points of the rendered frontier at its cost. Every near-frontier model family must be in the primary ranking, with its own selected configuration, or be explicitly deferred with a dated, reasoned roster decision. The cost ratio to the cheapest frontier point of equal or higher intelligence is reported for information only.

requiredFamilyPolicy: Every distinct frontier model family must have an exact selected frontier configuration in the primary ranking. Alternate efforts remain comparison rows with separate evidence.
nearFrontierFamilyPolicy: Every near-frontier model family must have a row in the primary ranking using its own selected configuration, or a dated defer decision for each of its near-frontier configurations.
